## 1. Use

Use one form per scoped concern and assign a unique ID. Actual records belong in private storage. M = mandatory value or explicitly owned unknown; C = conditional with applicability reason; O = optional. Unknown does not mean N/A. Urgent-response arrangements take precedence over paperwork.

## 2. Context and assessment fields

| Field | Class | Entry / validation |
|---|---|---|
| record_id / originating form revision | M | Unique ID / ORR-FRM-GEN-001 r01 |
| concern_id / action_ids / control_ids | M for linked entries | Match register namespaces; repeat an action section for each assigned action |
| scope / reporter role / date with timezone | M | Actual context; do not infer identity or time |
| objective / observed facts / supporting evidence | M | Separate observation from inference; unavailable evidence explicitly stated |
| risk / existing controls / missing information | M | Specific exposure and owned gaps; adopted method reference |
| control performer / action / trigger / where / why / method and criterion / evidence | M when proposing control | All 5W+1H plus evidence; broad aspirations are insufficient |
| consultation and dissent | C | Record affected-party input or scoped reason no consultation applies |
| leadership agenda / decision reference | C | Required when adopted escalation criteria apply |
| decision / authority / rationale / resources | M for decision | Pending until legitimate authority and prerequisites exist |
| action owner / due trigger / receiving acknowledgment | M for assignment | Explicit owner and acknowledgment; missing receipt stays open |
| agreed outcome criterion / review method and trigger | M before implementation | Record the intended result and how it will be evaluated; control performance and action completion alone do not demonstrate the outcome |
| implementation evidence / outcome evidence | M for review | Separate IDs and limitations; neither inferred from form completion |
| review conclusion / closure authority / remaining open items | M for closure | Missing evidence blocks closure; actual approvals only |
| correction_of / prior value / reason / actor / date | C | Required when correcting an entry; preserve original |
| comments | O | Relevant non-sensitive context |

## 3. Decision and filing

Reviewer signs/acknowledges only within actual role; delegated authority makes the scoped decision separately. File the record and evidence references under the register's unique ID. Custodian applies actual access, retention and legal holds; preserve without automatic deletion until those are established. Do not upload populated real forms to this public repository.

## 4. History

r01: original form schema; blank entries are not completed checks or signatures.
